title: Collecting Souls of Whiskers Past
description: Collecting Souls of Whiskers Past — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Kill Rattle Tooths's Vengeful Soul in Rattle Tooth's Revenge to collect Rattle Tooth's Soul in a Baubel. Kill Sissirat's Vengeful Soul to collect Sissirat's Soul in a Baubel. Kill Vergrim's Vengeful Soul to collect Vergrim's Soul in a Baubel. When you have them all return to the Townston Commander.

Quest Reward: Gold and 4 King's Coins

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: No

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Kill Rattle Tooths's Vengeful Soul in Rattle Tooth's Revenge to collect Rattle Tooth's Soul in a Baubel. Kill Sissirat's Vengeful Soul to collect Sissirat's Soul in a Baubel. Kill Vergrim's Vengeful Soul to collect Vergrim's Soul in a Baubel. When you have them all return to the Townston Commander.

Offer:

Good news: everyone thinks you are the bee's knees! Bad news: I used the Soul crystals to blow up my huge crystal blocks in Puzzle Runner II Turbo HD Extreme and now I need you to and collect the crystals again. I will make it worth you while, don't you worry.

In no particular order I need you to get the following items: Rattle Tooth's Soul, Sissirat's Soul, and Vergrim's Soul. Rattle Tooth's Soul in a Bauble can be found in Rattle Tooth's Revenge, which is located off of The Whisker's Library - Propaganda Section in Level 1 of Ratsputin's Gulag. Sissirat's Soul in a Bauble can be found in Sissirat's Revenge, which is located off of The Whisker's Library - Edict Section in Level 4 of Ratsputin's Gulag. Vergrim's Soul in a Bauble can be found in Vergrim's Revenge, which is located off of The Whisker's Library - Dogma Section in Level 7 of Ratsputin's Gulag. Bring their souls back to me, the Townston Commander, and you will get your reward.

Turn-in:

You have them! Phew, I am about to lose to Dan! Wait...wait...I'm not supposed to use these to clear blocks in Puzzle Runner II Turbo HD Extreme! Dang, I almost did it again. Oh, who am I kidding, I am totally going to use these in Puzzle Runner II Turbo HD Extreme. You ready to go get me some more.

Objectives:

  • Rattle Tooth's Soul in a Baubel ×1
  • Sissirat's Soul in a Baubel ×1
  • Vergrim's Soul in a Baubel ×1

Client level range: 81–100
